# P067 · Prescription Rules (P-series)

Single-rule view — the full series catalog lives at [`prescriptions.md`](../prescriptions.md#p067).

```python
# conformance: ignore[P067] intentional: <why this is deliberate here>
```

## P067 — `TempDirOutsideRunScratch` {#p067}

**Tier:** `warn` · **Scope:** `app` · **Category:** `workflow-sandbox` · **Autofixable:** — · **Since:** 0.61.0

> `tempfile.gettempdir()` / `mkdtemp` / `mkstemp` without `dir=` in app code (use `self.run_scratch_dir`)

**Rationale:** A run's local files belong in the run's scratch directory, which the SDK owns.
tempfile's system temp dir breaks in workflow code (the sandbox refuses tempfile), is
never removed by cleanup_files (so it fills the worker's disk run after run), and has no
object-store mapping.

### What correct looks like

- **Compliant example:** application_sdk/app/base.py `App.run_scratch_dir` — the run's scratch directory,
  computed from the run's context with string-only os.path calls, so it is the same in
  workflow code and in every task of the run, and it is the directory `cleanup_files`
  removes when the run ends. No reference app reads it yet: the canonical apps still
  make per-task directories with mkdtemp and no dir=, which this rule flags
  (https://github.com/atlanhq/application-sdk/blob/main/docs/concepts/apps.md).
- **Migrate with:** [`programs/areas/prescriptions.prose.md`](https://github.com/atlanhq/application-sdk/blob/main/packages/conformance/conformance/programs/areas/prescriptions.prose.md)

App code calls `tempfile.gettempdir()` (or `gettempdirb()`), or `tempfile.mkdtemp(...)`
/ `tempfile.mkstemp(...)` without a directory, so the run's files land in the system
temp dir:

* in workflow code the sandbox refuses `tempfile` — at call time, and for a module-level
  call at import time — so the workflow task fails;
* `cleanup_files` removes only the run's scratch directory, so `/tmp/<app>/<run>` stays
  on the worker after every run;
* the SDK maps `./local/tmp/...` paths to object-store keys, and a `/tmp/...` path falls
  outside that mapping.

Fix — use the App's run scratch directory:

```python
# before
output = Path(tempfile.gettempdir()) / 'my-app' / self.run_id
# after
output = Path(self.run_scratch_dir)
```

`self.run_scratch_dir` is the same string in `run()` and in every `@task` of the run, is
safe in workflow code, and is removed by `cleanup_files` when the run ends.  Create it
in a task (`os.makedirs(..., exist_ok=True)`), never in `run()`.  For `mkdtemp` /
`mkstemp` in a task, pass `dir=self.run_scratch_dir`.  Code outside an App method (a
client, a helper) takes the directory as a parameter from its caller.  Code that runs
outside any workflow run (an HTTP handler, a CLI) has no run scratch directory: suppress
the finding with the reason, and remove what it creates itself.

Moving a path from `/tmp/...` to `./local/tmp/...` changes where the files are; check
what else reads the path (an output prefix passed on to other code, say) before
switching.

Silent unless the app's `uv.lock` resolves an `atlan-application-sdk` that ships
`App.run_scratch_dir`.  A call that splats `*args` / `**kwargs` is not flagged, nor are
`TemporaryDirectory` / `NamedTemporaryFile`, which remove themselves.  Test directories
are not scanned.  See
https://github.com/atlanhq/application-sdk/blob/main/docs/concepts/apps.md.

Land as `WARN`: a justified inline `# conformance: ignore[P067] <reason>` records a
deliberate exception and stays visible in SARIF.
